description:
Send a test event to a configured webhook and report whether your endpoint accepted it. Returns success, the HTTP status your endpoint returned, and any error message.

Pass agent_id to test that agent's webhook. Omit to test the project-level webhook. Each call dispatches a real event to your endpoint, so it is not a no-op to repeat.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to test that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

name: test_webhook

outputSchema.description: The result of sending a test event to the webhook.

errorMessage.description: Error message if the test failed, or null.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned, or null.

success.description: Whether your endpoint accepted the test event.

title: Test Webhook
